latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.20

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.20. All three engine families (`strata-engine`, `strata-inkling`, and `strata-hy4`) and Control are updated to 0.1.66 across every supported platform and backend. The update feeds are sequence 132 (shared) and 128 (`linux-aarch64`).

## What changes for you

- **Unified 4-tier GPU + RAM + CPU + SSD Mixture-of-Experts execution across Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY-4 Flash, and Inkling 2 Mini — down to 4 GiB GPUs.**
  - All three MoE families now share Strata's adaptive 4-tier planner: dense trunk + elastic/quantized KV on GPU (with automatic `--kv-offload auto` host KV offloading for 32K+ context on mid-VRAM cards), hot experts in remaining VRAM (down to `0` VRAM experts cleanly on **4 GiB / 6 GiB** WDDM & Linux GPUs), cold experts in pageable RAM with persistent SIMD CPU worker compute + async PCIe miss-sharing, and SSD Engram / expert streaming — plus first-class **GPU+SSD only** (`--ssd-experts --ram-experts-gb 0`) and **CPU+SSD only** modes.
  - **Multi-GPU `--layer-split auto` (`2..4` GPUs)** now works seamlessly across Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY-4 Flash, and Inkling 2 Mini.
- **Major Unsloth GGUF & Strata Quant speedups across every hardware tier (`4 GB` to `32 GB+`, DGX Spark, Strix Halo, Apple Metal, AMD RDNA2/3/3.5/4, Intel Arc SYCL, NVIDIA Pascal–Blackwell):**
  - **Lossless direct `GGUF_RAW` Inkling 2 Mini execution (`UD-Q4_K_XL`, `Q8_0`, `UD-IQ4_XS`, `UD-IQ3_XXS`, `UD-Q6_K_XL`, `UD-Q5_K_XL`, `UD-Q3_K_XL`, `UD-Q2_K_XL`)** with fixed DSpark speculative drafter (**`9.5x` speedup, `6.5 -> 61.9 tok/s` on 12 GB GPUs**; **`73.4 tok/s` multi-buffer `SQ-15`/`SQ-20` on Apple Silicon**).
  - **NVIDIA CUDA (`sm_60..sm_121`, including Tesla V100 `sm_70`):** all 13 Unsloth expert pairs enabled in fused `EXP_MODE=8` (**`1.04x–1.67x`** faster MoE decode, up to **`2.58x`** down projection) + 10 INT8 Tensor Core dense formats (**`1.78x–3.26x`** faster DFlash2 verify & chunked prefill).
  - **Apple Silicon Metal:** native `IQ3_XXS`, `Q2_K`, `Q3_K`, `Q8_0`, `NVFP4`, and halved-load `W8<IQ4_XS/IQ4_NL>` across decode and ragged `moe_mm` prefill (**up to `526 GB/s` / `89.9%` peak bandwidth and `6,769 tok/s` prefill on M5 Max**).
  - **AMD HIP (`RDNA2 / RDNA3 / RDNA3.5 Strix Halo / RDNA4`):** unified Wave32 WMMA prefill (**`70.7 TFLOPS` dense, `28.5–36.7 TFLOPS` fused dequant-to-LDS**) + 6-op `v_perm_b32` LUT16 Wave32 DP4A decode (**`451–583 GB/s`**).
  - **Intel Arc SYCL (`Alchemist` & `Battlemage`):** hoisted multi-token `Split<TY>`/`KqSplit<TY>` + SG16 XMX SLM decoders (**`1.37x–2.73x` faster across `IQ3_XXS`, `Q8_0`, `IQ4_XS`, `Q4_K`, and `NVFP4`**).
  - **CPU Cold-Expert SIMD & Tier Sizing:** **`5.59x–5.95x`** faster `quantize_q8_K`, **`+16.5%..+54.8%`** faster AVX2/AVX-512 cold-expert dot kernels (`Q8_0 +54.8%`, `IQ4_XS +32.7%`, `Q4_K +26.6%`), and exact heterogeneous Unsloth per-layer slot sizing (`#4870`, `#6354`).
- **HY-4 Flash `4.27x` hybrid RAM+VRAM boost & Intel Raptor Lake crash fix (`strata-hy4` 0.1.66 across all 15 platforms):**
  - Boosts `RTX 5090 + 128 GB DDR5` `SQ-64` generation **`30 -> 128.25 tok/s` (`4.27x`)** and Intel Arc Pro B70 SYCL prefill **`4.11x`**.
  - Fixes `0xC000001D` `STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` crashes on Intel 12th/13th/14th-Gen Alder Lake & Raptor Lake CPUs (`#6541`, `#6570`, `0` EVEX `zmm` instructions in AVX2 translation units).
- **Critical `NVFP4`, Long-Context `NaN` (`#879`), WDDM, & Setup Stability Fixes:**
  - **Fixed `NVFP4` mixed-language / garbled output & `0%` speculative acceptance** (`#6575`, `#6576`, `#6577`, `#6584`, `#6616`, `#6634`) by restoring per-expert `L.s_down` tail scaling in `use_sub8` / multi-token / SYCL / Metal / HIP paths, `L.had_block == 0` guards on fused `EXP_MODE=8`, and 2-byte-aligned mixed-blob loads.
  - **Fixed `24K–45K` long-prompt `#879` non-finite (`NaN`) outputs** (`#6431`) by eliminating `65,535` CUDA/HIP/SYCL/Metal grid-dimension overflow and `0/0` zero-amax quantization, plus automatic `--kv-offload auto` on `strata-ink

Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Tencent Hy4-Flash | Pack | Your RAM | Graphics card | | --- | --- | --- | | **SQ-64** | 64 GiB | 8, 12 or 16 GiB | | **SQ-96** | 96 GiB | 8 or 12 GiB | | **SQ-128** | 128 GiB | 8 or 12 GiB | The number in the name is the RAM the pack is made for. [Hy4-Flash packs on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/strata-engine/Hy4-Flash-Strata)
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
 Inkling 2 Mini | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **Strata** | SQ-20 (19.35 GB), SQ-15 (14.35 GB), SQ-10 (10.47 GB) | | **Unsloth** | UD-Q8\_K\_XL (22.87 GB), UD-Q4\_K\_XL (17.63 GB), UD-Q4\_K\_M (16.61 GB), UD-IQ4\_XS (15.73 GB), UD-Q3\_K\_XL (13.63 GB), UD-IQ3\_XXS (11.66 GB), UD-Q2\_K\_XL (9.14 GB), UD-IQ2\_XXS (8.49 GB), UD-IQ1\_M (8.02 GB), UD-IQ1\_S (7.76 GB) | SQ-20 is made for a 24 GiB graphics card, SQ-15 for 16 GiB and SQ-10 for 12 GiB. A 4 GiB card is enough to start. [Strata packs on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/strata-engine/Inkling-2-Mini-Strata) · [Unsloth GGUF files](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF)
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.20-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.20-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.20-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
